evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Streaming video understanding requires Vision Language Models (VLLMs) to process growing video streams and answer user questions under tight latency constraints.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments show that CoFiE establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple video understanding benchmarks, reaching 78.86% accuracy on StreamingBench and 68.72% on OvO-Bench, with improvements of up to 3.15% over prior methods.
